Usage: deckent <command> [options]

Surfaces (one installation, one set of typed operations):
  deckent             the interactive terminal on a real terminal; this help
                      when piped
  deckent <command>   this CLI: one call, one result; text for people, --json
                      for scripts and AI agents
  deckent-mcp         MCP server: Deckent operations as tools for AI clients;
                      policy grants decide which ones they may use

Commands (deckent <command> --help shows each action and its options):

Getting started:
  terminal    Open the interactive terminal
      workline | session | status | chat-plan | snapshot
      [--scope <id>] [--full-access]
  init        Set up an installation
      preview | inspect | apply | resume | identity | policy | pool | registry
      [--json] [--yes --scope <id>] [--preview] [--profile <file>]

Observe:
  report      Inspect cost and acceptance evidence for a Run
      [--scope <id>] [--run <id>] [--verbose]
  monitor     Watch installations and work
      [--once|--json] [--scope <id>]
  workers     List or watch workers (without an action: list)
      list | watch
      [--scope <id>] [--all | --since <12h>] [--verbose] [--limit <n>]
  memory      Read and curate the scope's memory journal: facts and lessons
      search | inspect | propose | verify | retire
      [--scope <id>] [--state <name>] [--json]
  agents      Read and define the scope's agents and skills
      inspect | skills | skill | define | define-skill
      [--scope <id>] [--json]

Execute work:
  do          Plan an intent through Brain and existing approval gates
      --request <text> [--scope <id>]
  run         Create and manage Runs
      list | create | propose | inspect-proposal | reserve | inspect | cancel |
      close | hold | resume
      [--scope <id>] [--id <id>]
  task        Execute, evaluate and deliver Tasks
      inspect | execute | evaluate | accept | reject | patch-prepare |
      patch-preview | integration-check | integration-prepare |
      integration-inspect | integration-queue-enqueue | integration-queue-list |
      integration-queue-inspect | integration-queue-confirm |
      integration-queue-rollback | integration-deliver | integration-adopt |
      integration-rollback | transcript
      --scope <id> --run <id> --task <id>
  pool        Inspect, hold or resume a pool (without an action: status)
      status | set-capacity | hold | resume | quota-release
      [--scope <id>] [--pool <id>]
  decide      Prepare, ask and record advisory decisions
      prepare | ask | record | outcome | inspect
      [--scope <id>] [--input <file|->]

Models:
  models      Inspect and manage models
      binding | activation | activate | deactivate | invoke | invocation |
      purge-content | cancel | spending | reconcile-spending | create-budget |
      revise-budget | audit-spending | connect |
      catalog list|register|activate|deactivate
      [--scope <id>] [--declared] [--catalog] [--verbose]

Approvals:
  approval    Inspect and decide approval requests (without an action: list)
      list | inspect | decide | renew
      [--scope <id>] [--input <file|->]
  policy      Inspect policy and standing grants (without an action: status)
      vocabulary | status | delegations | delegate | undelegate | grants |
      revoke | upgrade | mcp list|grant|revoke | scopes
      [--scope <id>]

Setup / Maintenance:
  audit       Verify audit history and checkpoint evidence
              (without an action: verify)
      verify | rebaseline
      [--scope <id>]
  backup      Create, verify and restore recovery sets
      create | verify | restore
      [<action> --scope <id> --set <path>]
  identity    Identity profiles, draft previews and governed distribution
      profiles | preview | choices | distribute
      [--scope <id>] [--verbose]
  config      Inspect and change configuration
      get | explain | validate | set | unset
      [<key> [<value>]] [--global]
  mcp         Manage MCP servers
      add | add-json | import | list | get | remove | approve | revoke
      [<name>] [--check] [--scope local|project|user]
  secret      Manage stored secrets (without an action: list)
      list | set | delete | grant | revoke | handover | store
      [<name>] [--scope <id>]
  toolchains  Check or update worker toolchains
      update
      [update [--apply]]
  doctor      Check installation health
      [--verbose] [--toolchains] [--json]

Developer:
  inventory   Inspect recorded attempts
      [--scope <id>] [--after <id>] [--limit <n>]
  paths       Inspect installation paths
      [--global]
  runtime     Manage the local runtime service (without an action: describe)
      serve | describe | shutdown | restart
  coding      Prepare native coding profiles
      prepare | template | instructions status|trust|revoke
      --input <file|-> | --provider <id> --kind <id>
  inference   Inspect local inference capacity
      plan | budget | metrics
      [--profile <id>]
  operation   Execute or inspect typed operations
      execute | compensate | inspect
      --input <file|-> [--wait <ms>]

Options:
  -h, --help          help; deckent <command> [<action>] --help for one command
  -v, --version       version and build
  --json              one machine-readable result on stdout; errors on stderr
  --lang en|tr        output language
  --no-color          plain text without colours
  --scope <id>        the scope a command works in (see each command)
  --full-access       open the terminal in full-access mode

Without an action a command runs the read named above, acts on its own
(terminal, init, monitor, models, config, doctor, paths), or lists its actions
and names the missing argument (exit 2).
Exit codes: 0 OK, 1 error, 2 usage, 78 configuration.
Examples: deckent doctor --json · deckent pool · deckent run --help
